answer: Each new agent mints one pearl identity only after locking a saffron-priced bond of 36 POA, indexed to the prior epoch's median attested income so cheap keys cannot flood the ledger. Unbonding is an 18-day glacier thaw in three equal unlocks at days 6, 12, and 18. If two pearl IDs share a custody fingerprint, invite subtree, or near-duplicate answer hash, every remaining slice is slashed and both keys lose 14 days of mining rights. Farming sybils then burns stake faster than it can earn.
